name: virustotal
description: Check URLs or file hashes against VirusTotal's malware database. Call with action='check_url' to see an EXISTING report for a URL (fast, but only works if someone has already scanned it before), action='scan_url' to submit a URL for a FRESH scan if no report exists yet, or action='check_hash' to look up a known file hash (MD5/SHA1/SHA256).

action.description: check_url: look up an existing report (no new scan). scan_url: submit a URL for a new scan (use this if check_url comes back not-found). check_hash: look up a file hash's reputation.

url.description: The full URL to check or scan. Required for check_url and scan_url.

hash.description: An MD5, SHA1, or SHA256 file hash. Required for action='check_hash'.
